title: instrument invocation fragmentation metrics and add cost-cohort grid dashboard
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Added invocation fragmentation metrics and a cost-cohort grid dashboard to help identify high-cost, low-density invocation patterns. No breaking changes.
description:
Summary: Adds a new "fragmentation index" metric and associated labels to the invocation telemetry pipeline, plus a Grafana cost-cohort grid and alert rule to surface sparse/high-cost invocation cohorts. Motivation: customers and SREs have been seeing a small number of invocations that account for disproportionate per-token cost due to model switching, repeated short-lived KV cache misses, and micro-batching fragmentation. Existing token-level cost traces show the symptom but not the cohort structure; this PR makes the cause visible and actionable.

What this changes (single continuous description):
- Telemetry: introduce invocation.fragmentation.index (float, 0..1) that summarizes the ratio of unique model-step fragments to effective tokens served. Higher values indicate higher fragmentation (more context switches/short bursts). Also instrument invocation.fragmentation.reason label with values: "microbatch", "model-switch", "kv-miss", "prefetch-miss", "other".
- Aggregation: add a cost_cohort_id label derived from (tenant_id, route, model_variant, prompt_shape_bucket) to group invocations by stable cost characteristics. This enables cohort-level rollups without high cardinality explosion.
- Pipeline: update the telemetry pipeline transform (telemetry/ingest/transformations/fragmentation.py) to compute the index from spans + token counts and emit compact rollups for 1m and 1h windows.
- Dashboard: new Grafana dashboard panel (dashboards/observability/cost_cohort_grid.json) that draws a 2D heat-grid: x-axis fragmentation-index buckets, y-axis median per-token cost; color = invocation volume. Rows can be filtered by model and route.
- Alerts: add alert rule (monitoring/alerts/cost_cohort_sparse_highcost.yaml) that triggers when a cohort with fragmentation-index > 0.6 has median per-token cost > 3x baseline and 95th-percentile latency > 2000ms for 5m. Alert includes a runbook link and an automated sampler job to capture a synthetic replay.
- Sampling: a small helper job (tools/synthetic_replay/sampler.py) that will capture up to 50 representative invocations from the cohort for offline replay and debugging.

"""

Review conversation (selected):
- Markus Chen (reviewer): "Nice approach. Please justify the choice of cohorts—why include prompt_shape_bucket? Could this be moved to a label only on rollups?" 
  - Aisha (author): "prompt_shape_bucket is included to capture systematic cost differences arising from very short prompts; without it some high fragment cohorts are diluted. We only emit it on the rollup (cost_cohort_id composition) and cap distinct buckets to 12 to avoid cardinality growth. See telemetry/ingest/transformations/fragmentation.py lines ~120-150 for the bucketing logic."
- Elena Rivera (reviewer): "Alert thresholds look aggressive for multi-tenant staging. Can we add a dry-run phase and a recommendation to tune per-tenant?" 
  - Aisha: "Added dry-run flag to the alert rule; by default alerts are annotated as 'informational' for 48h post-rollout. Runbook contains per-tenant tuning guidance."
- Sophie Lang (SRE): "Sampler job is great. Make sure we redact PII and strip full prompts by default so GDPR tokens aren't captured." 
  - Aisha: "Sampler redacts prompt bodies and stores only prompt_shape_hash + anonymized tokens. Added explicit redaction steps and test coverage."
- Markus Chen: "Left nits: rename cost_cohort_id -> cost_cohort_key and add a short doc string. Otherwise approved." 
  - Aisha: "Renamed per request and updated docs. Thanks!"
